fields.summary: TC-MTA-002: Market Time Adjustment - Original Leg Delayed More Than 15 Minutes Becomes Non-Original - LCO Eligible

content.text: Linked Story: Market Time Adjustment
Precondition: A crew member has an original leg assigned in V0. The leg is delayed by more than 15 minutes. isOriginal = TRUE initially.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a crew member with an original leg on flight 123 HOU-DAL in V0 with a planned departure time
Flight 123 HOU-DAL, isOriginal=TRUE, plannedDepTime=08:00, V0
Original leg is set up successfully in V0
Apply a market time adjustment delay of more than 15 minutes to the original leg
Delay = 16 minutes, newDepTime=08:16, changeType=Market Time Adjustment
Market time adjustment of more than 15 minutes is applied to the leg
Navigate to COA Search App and retrieve the COA record for the crew member
COA Search App - search by crew ID and trip
COA record is retrieved successfully
Verify the leg is treated as Non-Original after a delay of more than 15 minutes
isOriginal flag in COA record for the leg
isOriginal = FALSE. A delay of more than 15 minutes changes original status to Non-Original.
Verify the leg is evaluated for LCO eligibility
LCO field in COA record
LCO: Eligible for evaluation. Leg is Non-Original and must be assessed for LCO.
